updates.text: All 60 defensive snaps at safety next to Rambo and five on the kicking game, with eight tackles, seven solo, and a pass defended, the incompletion for Antonio Brown at 0:45 of the second quarter on the possession that ended in Suisham's field goal. Three of the tackles came on Pittsburgh's 80-yard touchdown drive in the fourth quarter: Bell's 2-yard run on second-and-6, Blount's 6-yard run on third-and-4 and, shared with Daryl Smith, Roethlisberger's 3-yard scramble on second-and-8. The play-by-play records the tackle and not the fit or the coverage, so the run support on that drive is a film item for the staff. A minor lower-extremity injury was logged at the end of that drive, at 2:28 of the fourth quarter; he was not removed and was on the field for the three kneel-downs that ended the game: out, projected return October 11, reassessment October 7 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/brynden_trawick_2014-10-05.md)). No role change follows from the instruction; the Week 6 safety pairing is Stone's after the reassessment.
